name: Input-Output
shortcutSummary: Track how the machine rearranges elements step by step. Identify the rule (e.g., smallest number moves to left, words arrange alphabetically). Apply the same rule to predict the next step.
conceptExplanation: Input-Output questions describe a "machine" that rearranges a given input (mix of words and numbers) step by step according to a hidden rule. You must identify the rule and predict intermediate or final steps.

subtopics.name: Input-Output — Core Concepts
subtopics.explanation: Input-Output questions describe a "machine" that rearranges a given input (mix of words and numbers) step by step according to a hidden rule. You must identify the rule and predict intermediate or final steps.
shortcuts: Step-by-Step Tracking: Write out each step to see what changes.
One Element Per Step: Usually, only one element moves per step — identify which one.
Dual Arrangement: Often, numbers sort in one direction and words in another (e.g., numbers ascending from left, words alphabetically from right).
